review: All four packages show twelve cases per method.
Labels, ticks, symbols and captions are readable without overlap or clipping.
PFJAX zoom excludes ten A points and one B point; displayed counts agree with data.
Full-range figure retains every selected point, failures and floor scores.
Paired figure retains all 48 pairs, including the PyDPF floor difference in its separate axis window.
No observation was removed from medians, boxes or density calculations.
Wording names original functions and external Adam; no three-proven-advantages or author-approval claim.
